about.title: About EzKey
about.description:
EzKey is an open-source, self-hosted cryptographic multi-factor authentication platform, in public alpha.
Sign-in requests arrive only when you check for them: there are no notifications, by design.

page.title: EzKey
page.empty: This device is not enrolled yet. Ask your administrator for an EzKey invitation, then scan its QR code.

scan.title: Scan an invitation QR code
scan.subtitle: The QR code your administrator gave you.

paste.title: Enter an invitation manually
paste.subtitle: Paste the content of the invitation QR code.
paste.dialogMessage: Paste the content of the invitation QR code.

forget.title: Remove from this device
forget.confirmMessage: This device will no longer receive sign-in requests for $integration. The enrollment still exists on the EzKey server: ask your administrator to revoke it.

scan.title: Scan an EzKey invitation
scan.notAnInvitation: This QR code is not an EzKey invitation.

server.title: EzKey server
server.message: This invitation does not say which EzKey server to use. Enter the address your administrator gave you.

enroll.title: Confirm the enrollment
enroll.intro: Check who is asking before you continue.
enroll.administrator: This invitation enrolls an EzKey administrator account.
enroll.codeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code your administrator gave you separately. It is not in the QR code.
enroll.abandonWarning: If you leave now, this invitation can no longer be used and you will need a new one.
enroll.success: This device is now enrolled for $integration.

error.alreadyEnrolled: This device is already enrolled with this invitation.
error.invitationAlreadyUsed: This invitation has already been used. Ask your administrator for a new one.
error.invitationExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
error.invitationRejected: The EzKey server rejected this invitation. Ask your administrator for a new one.
error.wrongCode: Wrong enrollment code. For your security, this invitation can no longer be used: ask your administrator for a new one.
error.integrity: The answer of the EzKey server could not be verified, so nothing was saved. Contact your administrator.
error.network: The EzKey server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.keyStore: This device could not create or use its security key.
error.server: The EzKey server could not process the request. Try again later.

check.title: Check for sign-in requests
check.subtitle: Looks for a request waiting for your approval.

attempt.title: Sign-in request
attempt.intro: Someone is signing in with your account. Approve only if it is you.
attempt.codeHelp: Enter the code shown where you are signing in.
attempt.leaveHint: Leaving this screen declines the request.

result.failed: Wrong code: the sign-in was refused. Start it again where you are signing in.

attempt.noLongerActive: This request is no longer active. It may have been cancelled, answered or replaced by a newer one.
attempt.uncertain: Your answer was sent, but its result is unknown. Check where you are signing in.
attempt.integrity: This request could not be verified, so it was ignored. Contact your administrator.
attempt.leaveDenyFailed: The request could not be declined. It will expire on its own.
attempt.confirmReason: Confirm it is you to approve this sign-in.
